footnote_text: Represents two grants of RSUs. The first is a grant of 56,926 RSUs, 4,742 of which will vest on December 23, 2026 and the remaining will vest in eleven quarterly installments of 4,744 RSUs each, beginning on March 23, 2027. The second is a grant of 7,798 RSUs, 2,144 RSUs of which will vest on November 30, 2026 and 2,827 RSUs will vest on each of February 28, 2027 and May 31, 2027.
